_public_note: Public build manifest. Verbatim retail source strings are stored as SHA-256 digests (fields ending in _sha256); the builder recomputes them from the user's own ROM. Japanese text in this file is written by this project.
description: Final editorial localization of the US-only story lines that live inside JP leaves the leaf-repoint layer already rewrites (s_text tops 0, 1, 19, 26, 34), plus the closed NON_PRODUCTION_INTERNAL class (US top 36, the dead leaf). Depends on three story-leaf align anchors in CONF['text']['align']['s_text'] that move the JP developer cut-index labels of tops 1, 19 and 26 past the dialogue the US ROM inserted before them.

align_hints.why: JP 1/118..128 are 11 cut labels; US inserts 53 lines (snowball tutorial, post-fight, Randell at work, tutorial repeat) at 118..170 and carries the same 11 labels at 171..181
JP 19/101..109 are 9 cut labels; US inserts 6 lines (Cid remembers, the apology rewrite of JP 19/47,53..57) at 101..106 and carries the labels at 107..115
JP 26/71..76 are 6 cut labels; US 26/71 is a rewritten Mewt line (the rewrite of JP 26/20, read by scene FAT 77) and US 72..77 are empty records

non_production_internal.decode_note: retail_us_text_decoded prints the retail tokens through ffta_jp_charset (charset_us below 0x122, editorial kanji_codes, data/jp_kanji_glyph_reviewed.json -- Japanese sources only); a JP glyph code with no reviewed name prints as 〔JXXX〕. It is a listing for review, not the ROM content
non_production_internal.meaning: every visible line of US s_text top 36 is Japanese in the retail US ROM; the leaf is a near-verbatim copy of JP top 35 (43 lines differ only by spelling a [51xx] name control out literally), it is shared by root tops 40/41/43/54/56/57/58/59, and no scene-script program of either ROM issues a 0x0F text command against any of those owners (FAT 108 -> script group 35 has no pages; FAT 153..158 own tops 56..58 and contain no text command). Nothing is written; the builder re-proves the dead-leaf claim on every build.
